description: This file defines Drupal behaviors related to user permission page functionalities, including displaying inherited permissions with fake checkboxes and filtering permission lists via text input.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches behaviors for permission checkbox display and table filtering.

methods.name: tableRowProcessing
methods.description: Processes table rows to insert fake checkboxes for inherited permissions.

methods.name: hideEmptyPermissionHeader
methods.description: Hides permission headers with no visible permission rows after filtering.

methods.name: filterPermissionList
methods.description: Filters permission list table rows based on search input.

methods.name: preventEnterKey
methods.description: Prevents form submission on Enter key press within the filter input.
